scope: 87 API supplement operations; admin rows belong to developer-01
interface: await take(name, ctx) returns setup data and cleanup(ctx); register cleanup before returning custody, including partial setup failures. No run(case), pass flags, or expected responses derived from the operation under test.

environment.topology: Parent-owned two real AMs sharing isolated Mongo; direct ingress a/b and fresh Agent owner/epoch adapter. Never start an application from these cases.
environment.actors: user and outsider are distinct synthetic owners with manage_own_profiles. Admin has only the explicitly required local capabilities. Authentication credentials remain in the shared transport. Additional profile-denied is a synthetic account without manage_own_profiles; test public marketplace reads still work while exact authoring operations return typed 403.
environment.profile_policy: Local marketplace enabled by fixture owner; supported managed model defaults and public-value scanner. No warmup, runtime allocation, or production policy change by profile cases.
environment.cleanup: Public exact-resource retirement/deletion. Resources without deletion APIs remain in parent-owned disposable namespace; require namespace teardown evidence. Unknown create custody is a cleanup failure.
environment.routing: Requires shared runner f5d2d08d3 or newer: omit am for automatic non-owner Agent requests; explicit am selects exact ingress with owner/epoch proof. Cross-AM read helper derives the opposite AM from the actual preceding receipt and asserts actual read receipt attribution.
environment.private_evidence: Parent evidence sink must redact authentication, binding credentials and sealed event_ref capability values before serialization. Fixture callbacks keep credentials inside transport; no real-user data or secret values in observations. Cases do not print response bodies.

profile-authoring.setup: Synthetic public repository resolver fixture reachable by both AMs and identical safe NyxID service catalog; no user credentials in values.

capacity-recovery.setup: Disposable failed never-Ready Agent with original agent_id, creation_key, creation_fingerprint, failure_seq, requested_at and independently observed retained data. Local recovery gate must already be approved/enabled by owner.
controls: Read original immutable identity and retained data digest
capacity-recovery.native_limit: Current runtime proof producer is unsupported in the inspected source. Do not fabricate recovery evidence or enable gates from the case; take must throw Blocked until an owner-approved real local producer can reattach the exact original native target without preparation or input replay.

compatibility.setup: Disposable Agent/conversation and launch with a deterministic synthetic streaming provider, long-running response for cancellation and exact response/message IDs.
controls: Real SSE collection with original event order and IDs
compatibility.runner_requirement: Return bounded raw SSE as body:string and safe lower-case headers including content-type, preserving request_id and actual timing.am. Complete streams within 120 seconds; follow=false closes replay. Do not synthesize frames or collapse them to booleans.
compatibility.retention: The main agentId is retained under parent cleanup custody across N=3 pre-restart and N=1 post-restart. runState binds the previously completed response to that same Agent. Newly created conversation Agents are separately cleaned each invocation. Parent finality must prove retained Agent teardown.

delegation.setup: Synthetic event-bound provider claims, linked user consent and owned launch requiring one safe service handoff.
controls: Install synthetic claim variant without exposing tokens

agent-metadata.setup: Owned Agent with known source/provenance/provider association, exact feedback message, published synthetic artifact bytes/hash, deliverable lineage and denied outsider.
controls: Read independently seeded artifact and provenance values
agent-metadata.data_contract: artifact: {id,content,name,media_type,sha256}; feedback: {message_id,vote,version,reasons,comment,request_id}; provenance: {creation_origin,details}; source: {origin,trigger?}; associations: exact nonempty array of seeded binding lineage. All values synthetic and independently derived at setup.

capabilities.setup: Exact-image public conformance/v2/transport/task-experience capability manifest and content-free telemetry collector.
controls: Observe telemetry kind/count and absence of user content
capabilities.data_contract: manifest maps all four GET paths to independent exact-image capability documents; subjects has user and outsider synthetic subjects with the same configured capability policy. Telemetry collection is isolated for the duration of this case.

hierarchy.setup: Synthetic owner quota and real local runtime supporting documented Sandbox/Workspace/Agent creation, current defaults and worktree readback.
hierarchy.request_constraints: Explicit fixture profiles have empty automatic child lists and enough quota for one Sandbox, one Workspace and one Agent. Current defaults are independently supplied from fixture configuration; no secret reads.

documents.setup: Owned document with two committed synthetic revisions and two comments with distinct owners; immutable content/hash witnesses.
controls: Fixture namespace teardown; no invented document DELETE
documents.data_contract: revisions: [{revision,title,markdown}], comments: exact [{id,author_subject,body,document_revision,created_at}]. At least two committed source revisions and two comments. owner matches one target comment; outsider has no document access. Setup cleanup uses namespace teardown for durable documents without DELETE.

launches.setup: Published Trigger with real public placement and owned cancellable launch; separate unpublished draftTriggerId for DELETE; staleLaunchId and foreign otherOwnerTriggerId. Published Trigger DELETE must never be treated as supported.

usage.setup: Synthetic owner with at least two completed Sandbox allocation intervals, independent CPU/RAM/disk/uptime totals, stable as_of boundary and distinct denied owner.
usage.data_contract: ledger: at least two {sandbox_id,owner,name,status,allocation:{running:false,cpu_millis:0,memory_mib:0,disk_gib:0},created_at,tracking_started_at,complete_lifecycle,intervals:[{running:boolean,started_at,ended_at,cpu_millis,memory_mib,disk_gib}]}. Integer timestamp seconds and closed intervals; no other owner resources. Expected totals are calculated in the case, not supplied by the API.

adapter_methods.cleanup(ctx): Complete exact public cleanup through ctx and retain sanitized finality. A retained parent-owned fixture is explicitly transferred to parent cleanup custody; it cannot be silently left running.
adapter_methods.withAnonymousRequests(callback): Scope only the callback transport to omit authentication/cookies, restore it on failure; requests still go through ctx.request.
adapter_methods.withBindingVariant(variant, callback): Install synthetic binding/provider claim context for this callback, restoring valid context afterwards. No credential is passed into case data. Variants valid, wrong_audience, wrong_scope, wrong_resource, revoked, expired, provider_unavailable are independently configured upstream states.
adapter_methods.withManualRedirects(callback): Disable redirect following for callback requests, return safe lower-case response headers, restore afterward.
adapter_methods.readNativeFacts(): Independent current instrumentation of fixture-owned resource/effect facts, not the response being asserted and never a boolean case verdict.
adapter_methods.waitForOwner(agentId): Bounded independent live owner/epoch/readiness wait; no inference from successful HTTP or fixed delay.
adapter_methods.cleanupResource(ctx, kind, id): Use exact public Agent/Workspace/Sandbox lifecycle cleanup and wait for terminal finality. Preserve parent and child cleanup failure independently.
adapter_methods.cleanupConversation(ctx, agentId): Exact public deletion of the newly created conversation Agent and settlement of associated child resources.
adapter_methods.holdNextTurn()/waitForHeldTurnStarted(ag: Control only the isolated deterministic provider. Observe actual provider invocation before interrupt. Release is idempotent and bounded; no fabricated stream frames.
adapter_methods.makeNextAdmissionOutcomeUnknown(): Inject uncertainty at the original local recovery commit boundary so the real route returns 202 unknown after one admission; restore fault on cleanup.
adapter_methods.setBrokerHandoffState(id, state): Advance synthetic upstream broker handoff to satisfied; the application must discover and persist it through real public polling.
adapter_methods.readTelemetry(): Read only isolated collector events as [{kind}], in order, without request identity, credentials or content.
